name: Exp_Stopreversal_Tm
summary: This EA implements a stop-and-reversal trading strategy that alternates between long and short positions, always being in the market. When the stop loss of the current position is hit, the EA immediately opens a reverse position, effectively reversing direction at each reversal point, with an added time filter to restrict trading to specific sessions.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了止损反转交易策略，在多头和空头之间交替切换，始终持仓。当当前仓位的止损被触发时，EA立即开立反向仓位，在每个反转点改变方向，并增加了时间过滤器来限制特定时段的交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典的止损反转（Stop and Reversal）策略，核心概念是始终持有仓位，当止损触发时自动反向下单。入场条件为：初始根据信号方向开仓，之后每次止损触发即反向开仓，相当于以止损点作为趋势反转的判断依据。出场条件仅依赖止损出场，无独立止盈逻辑，止损触发即平仓并反向开仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，每次开仓使用相同的手数，无加仓减仓机制。资金管理方面，该EA没有动态调整仓位大小的逻辑，风险完全取决于止损距离和固定手数的乘积。时间过滤器的加入允许用户限制交易时段，避免在不利时段（如低流动性时段）进行反转操作。该策略适合趋势明显且转折清晰的市场环境，但在震荡行情中会频繁止损反转导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements the classic Stop and Reversal (SAR) strategy, where the core concept is to always maintain a position and automatically reverse direction when the stop loss is triggered. Entry conditions: initially opens a position based on a signal direction, then each time the stop loss is hit, a reverse position is immediately opened, using the stop loss level as the trend reversal determination point. Exit conditions rely solely on stop loss exits with no independent take-profit logic; when the stop is triggered, the position closes and a reverse position opens. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where each trade uses the same lot size with no scaling or pyramiding mechanism. Money management lacks dynamic position sizing logic, so risk depends entirely on the product of the stop loss distance and the fixed lot size. The time filter addition allows users to restrict trading sessions, avoiding reversal operations during unfavorable periods such as low liquidity sessions. This strategy suits markets with clear trends and well-defined turning points but suffers from frequent stop-and-reverse losses in choppy or ranging markets.
pros: 始终持仓能捕捉大趋势行情，不会错过主要趋势方向
止损反转机制简单明确，逻辑清晰易于理解和验证
时间过滤器可避免低流动性时段的不利交易，降低滑点和点差风险
pros_en: Always-in-market approach captures major trend moves without missing primary directional moves
Stop-and-reversal mechanism is simple, clear, and easy to understand and verify
Time filter avoids unfavorable trades during low liquidity sessions, reducing slippage and spread risks
cons: 震荡行情中会频繁止损反转，造成连续亏损和手续费消耗
缺乏止盈机制，盈利完全依赖下一笔反向交易的止损不被触发
固定手数无资金管理，无法根据账户规模和波动性动态调整风险
cons_en: Frequent stop-and-reverse in ranging markets causes consecutive losses and commission drain
Lacks take-profit mechanism; profits depend entirely on the next reverse trade's stop not being triggered
Fixed lot sizing with no money management prevents dynamic risk adjustment based on account size and volatility
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如移动平均线或ADX），在震荡行情中暂停反转操作
引入动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和ATR自动调整手数大小
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as moving average or ADX) to pause reversal operations during ranging market conditions
Introduce dynamic position sizing that automatically adjusts lot size based on account balance and ATR

risk_points: 无独立止盈逻辑，盈利依赖止损距离设置是否合理
固定手数在连续反转亏损时无法自动降低仓位，存在加速亏损风险
risk_points_en: No independent take-profit logic; profitability depends on whether stop loss distance is set appropriately
Fixed lot size cannot automatically reduce exposure during consecutive reversal losses, creating accelerated loss risk
